wins.label: Strong earnings growth and ROTCE improvement
wins.evidence: diluted earnings per share was up 11% from a year ago, ROTCE improved to 13.4% in 2024 from 8% in 2020

wins.label: Regulatory progress with consent order closures
wins.evidence: sixth consent order terminated by regulators since 2019, OCC terminated 2016 sell practices consent order early last year

wins.label: Credit card business momentum and new product success
wins.evidence: over 2.4 million new credit card accounts opened in 2024, credit card spend up over $17 billion from a year ago, 11 new cards rolled out since 2021

wins.label: Diversified revenue growth reducing NII reliance
wins.evidence: strong fee-based revenue growth, up 15% from a year ago, largely offset expected decline in net interest income

wins.label: Capital return acceleration and shareholder returns
wins.evidence: returned $25 billion of capital to shareholders, repurchased approximately $20 billion of common stock, up 64% from a year ago

risks.label: Commercial real estate office portfolio weakness
risks.evidence: commercial real estate office fundamentals have not changed and remain weak, commercial net loan charge-offs increased to 30 basis points driven by office portfolio

risks.label: Net interest income pressure and rate sensitivity
risks.evidence: NII guidance of only 1-3% growth for 2025, rate cuts expected to be slight headwind, balance sheet becoming less rate sensitive

risks.label: Loan demand weakness and credit tightening impacts
risks.evidence: average loans declined throughout the year, weak loan demand, commercial clients remain cautious with no meaningful change in loan demand in Q4

risks.label: Cyber risk as primary operational concern
risks.evidence: biggest risk that we spend the most time talking about is cyber at this point, significant investment and resources required

risks.label: Asset cap constraint limiting balance sheet growth
risks.evidence: asset capital expected to remain in place throughout 2025, limits organic growth opportunities despite excess capital position
